Represents an award of Restricted Stock Units ("RSU"), each of which represents a contingent right to receive one Ordinary Share. The RSUs will vest upon the earlier to occur of: (i) the closing price of the AIR Global PLC ordinary shares is at or above $12.50 for 20 trading days over a consecutive 30-day period during the Earnout Period, and (ii) certain early release events, including an AIR Global PLC merger, consolidation or reorganization in which the AIR Global PLC ordinary shares are converted or exchanged for the right to receive cash or registered publicly listed securities equal to or exceeding $12.50 per ordinary share, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through the vesting date. Any RSUs that have not vested by May 14, 2031 will be forfeited
